name: v0.3.18
body:
## Changes

### ♻️ Refactoring
- Decompose CatalogPage into modular components (CatalogHeader, FilterBar, BuildsTable, VersionGroup, BuildRow)
- Extract dedicated hooks (useVersionSearch, useCatalogRefresh, useCatalogActions)
- Unify key generation into single buildKey module (makeKey, parseKey, getRowKey)
- Reduce CatalogPage from 827 to 226 lines for improved maintainability
